_doc: Sunbathers lying on the beach towels by the umbrellas (UMareVillageWorld::UpdateSunbathers, AMarePerson::LieOn). Present during 'hours' (game hours, start inclusive, end exclusive) on dry days; at most 'count' of them, in the order of 'towels'. Each towel: world cm centre [x, y, z] of the towel mesh (Maré · towel actors, 96 x 194 cm, long side along local Y) and its yaw; the body lies along the towel, head inland (towards +Y). loungers (pool day use bought): [x, y, seat top z, head yaw] of the pelvis point just in front of each pool lounger backrest hinge (measured with mare_hotel_lobby profile: seat 58 cm, backrest 63 -> 116 cm over 60 cm, ~40 deg); lounger_count of them are used; recline = torso bend (deg) at the waist. swimmers: [x, y, z, yaw, "pool"|"sea"]: at sea z is the water surface and they tread water (AMarePerson::TreadWater); the pool is 1.32 m deep (surface -8, floor -140), so there z is the floor and two people stand chatting with the water at the chest; sea level -30 riding the waves (AMarePerson::SeaHeight), sea spots where the floor is at least 1.6 m deep and away from the pier; pool ones only with the pool day use bought. Pool swimmers moved to pool_swim.json (UMarePoolSwimWorld, 06/11): they swim, float and chat there; 'pool' entries here are no longer used.
